chapterInfo.content:
9
Paulo ahopakyire nhwɛsoɔ
1 # 1 Ko 15.8; Aso 26.16; 22.17 Menne me ho anaa? Menyɛ ɔsomafoɔ anaa? Menhunuu yɛn Awurade Yesu anaa? Ɛnyɛ m’adwuma Awurade mu ne mo anaa? 2#2 Ko 3.2-3 Sɛ menyɛ ɔsomafoɔ mma ebinom a, mo deɛ meyɛ ɔsomafoɔ ma mo; ɛfiri sɛ me somafoyɛ nsɔano ne mo, Awurade mu. 3M’anoyie a meyi mekyerɛ wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me dwumadie mu nie.
4 # Luka 10.8 Yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛdidi na yɛnom? 5#Yoh 1.43 Yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛde onuabaa a ɔyɛ ɔyere kyini sɛ asomafoɔ a aka no ne Awurade nuanom ne Kefa? 6Anaasɛ mene Barnaba nko ara na yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛgyae adwumayɛ? 7Hwan na ɔkɔ sa na ɔno ara na ɔtua ne ho ka? Hwan na ɔyɛ bobeturo na ɔnni n’aba bie? Anaasɛ hwan na ɔhwɛ mmoakuo na ɔnnom wɔn nufosuo no bie?
8Meka yei nnipa fam, na mmara no nso nka saa? 9#Deut 25.4; 1 Ti 5.18 Na wɔatwerɛ Mose mmara no mu sɛ: Nkyekyere nantwie a ɔrepore aburoo no ano. Ɔnantwie no na ne ho hia Onyankopɔn, 10anaasɛ yɛn nti na ɔkaa saa? Na yɛn nti na wɔatwerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ deɛ ɔfuntum asase no sɛ ɔfuntum no anidasoɔ mu, na deɛ ɔpore aburoo no pore no anidasoɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛnya mu bi.
11 # Rom 15.27 Sɛ yɛduaa honhom fam nnoɔma maa mo a, ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛso, sɛ yɛbɛbu honam fam nnoɔma afiri mo hɔ? 12#Aso 20.34-35; 2 Ko 11.9 Sɛ nnipa bi wɔ mo so tumi yi bi a, yɛnni nsene wɔn anaa? Nanso yɛamfa saa tumi yi anyɛ deɛ yɛn ara yɛpɛ, na mmom yɛpene nnoɔma nyinaa so na yɛansi Kristo asɛmpa no kwan.
13 # Num 18.8; 18.31; Deut 18.1-3 Monnim sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ asɔredan mu adwuma no di asɔredan adeɛ no bie, na wɔn a wɔte afɔrebukyia ho no nso didi afɔrebukyia no ho? 14#Luka 10.7 Saa ara na Awurade nso ahyehyɛ sɛ, wɔn a wɔka n’asɛmpa no nnidi asɛmpa no ho.
15 # Aso 18.3 Na me deɛ, mamfa yeinom biara anyɛ hwee. Na mantwerɛ yeinom sɛ wɔnyɛ no saa mma me; na ɛyɛ ma me sɛ anka mɛwuo kyɛne sɛ obi bɛma m’ahohoahoa ayɛ kwa. 16#Yer 20.9 Na sɛ meka asɛmpa no a, ɛnyɛ adeɛ a mede hoahoa me ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɛtwa sɛ meka, na sɛ manka asɛmpa no a, mennue! 17#1 Ko 4.1 Na sɛ meyɛ no anigyeɛ so a, mewɔ akatua, sɛ nso manyɛ no anigyeɛ so a, wɔde efiehwɛ adwuma no ahyɛ me nsa ara. 18#1 Ko 8.9 Na afei m’akatua ne deɛ ɛwɔ he? Ɛne sɛ, meka asɛmpa no a, memfa akatua biara mmata ho na mamfa tumi a wɔde ama me wɔ asɛmpa no ho no manyɛ biribi.
19 # Mat 20.26-27 Na mede me ho adeɛ nyinaa mu deɛ, nanso mede me ho mayɛ akoa mama nnipa nyinaa na manya dodoɔ. 20#Aso 16.3; 21.20-26 Meyɛɛ me ho sɛ Yudani memaa Yudafoɔ, na manya Yudafoɔ; wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara aseɛ no, (ɛwom sɛ menhyɛ mmara ase deɛ,) nanso meyɛɛ me ho sɛ obi a ɔwɔ mmara aseɛ memaa wɔn, na manya wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara aseɛ no. 21#Gal 2.3 Wɔn a wɔnhyɛ mmara no aseɛ no, meyɛɛ me ho memaa wɔn sɛ obi a ɔnhyɛ mmara no ase, (ɛnyɛ sɛ menni mmara wɔ Nyankopɔn anim, mmom mewɔ Kristo mmara mu,) na manya wɔn a wɔnni mmara no. 22#2 Ko 11.29; Rom 11.14 Wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ no, meyɛɛ me ho sɛ obi a ɔyɛ mmerɛ memaa wɔn, na manya wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ no; mede me ho meyɛɛ ade nyinaa memaa nnipa nyinaa, na ɛyɛ deɛn ara a, magye ebinom nkwa. 23Na yei nyinaa, asɛmpa no nti na meyɛ, na manya emu nhyira no bi.
24 # 2 Ti 4.7 Monnim sɛ wɔn a wɔsi ammirika kan no, wɔn nyinaa tu ammirika no deɛ, nanso ɔbaako na ɔnya nkonim boɔ no anaa? Saa ara na montu ammirika, na moanya bi. 25#2 Ti 2.4-5; 1 Pe 5.4 Na obiara a ɔsi agodie kan no, ɔsɔn ne ho nnoɔma nyinaa mu; na wɔn deɛ, wɔyɛ na wɔanya abotire a ɛsɛeɛ, na yɛn deɛ, deɛ ɛnsɛeɛ. 26Saa nti, me deɛ, ammirika a metuo yi, mentu no asunsumabo, kuturukuo a mebɔ yi, memmɔ no sɛ deɛ ɔreboro mframa, 27#Rom 8.13; 13.14 na mmom mehyɛ me nipadua yea, na medi no nya, na mereka asɛm makyerɛ binom yi, me ara wɔanyi me totwene.

pageProps.chapterText:
Menne me ho anaa? Menyɛ ɔsomafoɔ anaa? Menhunuu yɛn Awurade Yesu anaa? Ɛnyɛ m’adwuma Awurade mu ne mo anaa? Sɛ menyɛ ɔsomafoɔ mma ebinom a, mo deɛ meyɛ ɔsomafoɔ ma mo; ɛfiri sɛ me somafoyɛ nsɔano ne mo, Awurade mu. M’anoyie a meyi mekyerɛ wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me dwumadie mu nie.
Yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛdidi na yɛnom? Yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛde onuabaa a ɔyɛ ɔyere kyini sɛ asomafoɔ a aka no ne Awurade nuanom ne Kefa? Anaasɛ mene Barnaba nko ara na yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛgyae adwumayɛ? Hwan na ɔkɔ sa na ɔno ara na ɔtua ne ho ka? Hwan na ɔyɛ bobeturo na ɔnni n’aba bie? Anaasɛ hwan na ɔhwɛ mmoakuo na ɔnnom wɔn nufosuo no bie?
Meka yei nnipa fam, na mmara no nso nka saa? Na wɔatwerɛ Mose mmara no mu sɛ: Nkyekyere nantwie a ɔrepore aburoo no ano. Ɔnantwie no na ne ho hia Onyankopɔn, anaasɛ yɛn nti na ɔkaa saa? Na yɛn nti na wɔatwerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ deɛ ɔfuntum asase no sɛ ɔfuntum no anidasoɔ mu, na deɛ ɔpore aburoo no pore no anidasoɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛnya mu bi.
Sɛ yɛduaa honhom fam nnoɔma maa mo a, ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛso, sɛ yɛbɛbu honam fam nnoɔma afiri mo hɔ? Sɛ nnipa bi wɔ mo so tumi yi bi a, yɛnni nsene wɔn anaa? Nanso yɛamfa saa tumi yi anyɛ deɛ yɛn ara yɛpɛ, na mmom yɛpene nnoɔma nyinaa so na yɛansi Kristo asɛmpa no kwan.
Monnim sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ asɔredan mu adwuma no di asɔredan adeɛ no bie, na wɔn a wɔte afɔrebukyia ho no nso didi afɔrebukyia no ho? Saa ara na Awurade nso ahyehyɛ sɛ, wɔn a wɔka n’asɛmpa no nnidi asɛmpa no ho.
Na me deɛ, mamfa yeinom biara anyɛ hwee. Na mantwerɛ yeinom sɛ wɔnyɛ no saa mma me; na ɛyɛ ma me sɛ anka mɛwuo kyɛne sɛ obi bɛma m’ahohoahoa ayɛ kwa. Na sɛ meka asɛmpa no a, ɛnyɛ adeɛ a mede hoahoa me ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɛtwa sɛ meka, na sɛ manka asɛmpa no a, mennue! Na sɛ meyɛ no anigyeɛ so a, mewɔ akatua, sɛ nso manyɛ no anigyeɛ so a, wɔde efiehwɛ adwuma no ahyɛ me nsa ara. Na afei m’akatua ne deɛ ɛwɔ he? Ɛne sɛ, meka asɛmpa no a, memfa akatua biara mmata ho na mamfa tumi a wɔde ama me wɔ asɛmpa no ho no manyɛ biribi.
Na mede me ho adeɛ nyinaa mu deɛ, nanso mede me ho mayɛ akoa mama nnipa nyinaa na manya dodoɔ. Meyɛɛ me ho sɛ Yudani memaa Yudafoɔ, na manya Yudafoɔ; wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara aseɛ no, (ɛwom sɛ menhyɛ mmara ase deɛ,) nanso meyɛɛ me ho sɛ obi a ɔwɔ mmara aseɛ memaa wɔn, na manya wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara aseɛ no. Wɔn a wɔnhyɛ mmara no aseɛ no, meyɛɛ me ho memaa wɔn sɛ obi a ɔnhyɛ mmara no ase, (ɛnyɛ sɛ menni mmara wɔ Nyankopɔn anim, mmom mewɔ Kristo mmara mu,) na manya wɔn a wɔnni mmara no. Wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ no, meyɛɛ me ho sɛ obi a ɔyɛ mmerɛ memaa wɔn, na manya wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ no; mede me ho meyɛɛ ade nyinaa memaa nnipa nyinaa, na ɛyɛ deɛn ara a, magye ebinom nkwa. Na yei nyinaa, asɛmpa no nti na meyɛ, na manya emu nhyira no bi.
Monnim sɛ wɔn a wɔsi ammirika kan no, wɔn nyinaa tu ammirika no deɛ, nanso ɔbaako na ɔnya nkonim boɔ no anaa? Saa ara na montu ammirika, na moanya bi. Na obiara a ɔsi agodie kan no, ɔsɔn ne ho nnoɔma nyinaa mu; na wɔn deɛ, wɔyɛ na wɔanya abotire a ɛsɛeɛ, na yɛn deɛ, deɛ ɛnsɛeɛ. Saa nti, me deɛ, ammirika a metuo yi, mentu no asunsumabo, kuturukuo a mebɔ yi, memmɔ no sɛ deɛ ɔreboro mframa, na mmom mehyɛ me nipadua yea, na medi no nya, na mereka asɛm makyerɛ binom yi, me ara wɔanyi me totwene.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
